columns.name: PIN10
columns.description: 10 digit parcel number, the first 10 digits of the parcel , often called the base parcel

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the parcel centroid (within the polygon)

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the parcel centroid (within the polygon)

columns.name: MUNICIPALITY
columns.description: Municipality name

columns.name: MunicipalityFIPS
columns.description: Municipality FIPS code

columns.name: PoliticalTownship
columns.description: Political Township name

columns.name: CommissionerDistrict
columns.description: Cook County Commissioner district

columns.name: CongressionalDistrict
columns.description: Congressional district

columns.name: StateRepresentativeDistrict
columns.description: Illinois State Representative district

columns.name: StateSenateDistrict
columns.description: Illinois State Senate district

columns.name: TIFDistrict
columns.description: TIF District name, if parcel is within a TIF District

columns.name: ElemSchlTaxDist
columns.description: Name of the elementary/middle school district the parcel falls within

columns.name: HighSchlTaxDist
columns.description: Name of the High School district the parcel falls within

columns.name: UnitSchlTaxDist
columns.description: Name of the Unit School district the parcel falls within

columns.name: ChicagoWard
columns.description: City of Chicago ward number, if parcel is within the City of Chicago

columns.name: CensusTract_GEOID
columns.description: Full Census FIPS code of the tract containing the parcel

columns.name: AssessorBLDGclass
columns.description: Codes for classification of REAL property assigned by the Assessor.

columns.name: AssessorNBHD
columns.description: Neighborhoods are based on similar characteristics such as sales and housing type.

columns.name: Tax code
columns.description: A tax code is a code which identifies the combination of taxing districts which provide services and levy property taxes to each tax parcel in Cook County.

columns.name: PARCELTYPE
columns.description: 1-Baseparcel, 2-Elevated, 3-Condominium, 4-NoPIN, 5-ElevatedCondo, 6-Leasehold, 7-ElevatedLeasehold, 8-ROWOverlap, 9-CondominiumLeasehold

columns.name: PINA
columns.description: First 2 digits of the parcel number, represents the Area number, (Township and Range)

columns.name: PINSA
columns.description: The 3rd & 4th digits of the parcel number, represents the subarea number (section of an Area)

columns.name: PINB
columns.description: The 5th, 6th & 7th digits, represents the Block area of the Parcel as assigned by the Clerks Office.

columns.name: PINP
columns.description: The 8th, 9th & 10th digits, that represent a Clerk assigned Parcel number.

columns.name: PINU
columns.description: the last 4 digits of the 14 digit number.  This is usually 0000, except in cases such as individual Condo units and Leasholds.  Individual units are not represented by a polygon.
